{{1974 Pacific-8 Conference football standings}}
The '''1974 Oregon State Beavers football team''' represented [[Oregon State University]] as a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference|Pacific-8 Conference]] (Pac-8) during the [[1974 NCAA Division I football season]]. In their tenth season under head coach [[Dee Andros]], the Beavers compiled an overall record of 3–8 record with a mark of 3–4 conference play, tying for fifth pace in the Pac-8, and were outscored 275 to 216. Oregon State played home games on campus at [[Reser Stadium|Parker Stadium]] in [[Corvallis, Oregon]].

With the team's 35–16 win over rival [[1974 Oregon Ducks football team|Oregon]] in the season finale, Andros' record improved to 9–1 over the Ducks in the [[Oregon–Oregon State football rivalry|Civil War]] game.
